_readme: Participant opt-out registry. A PID listed here receives NO automated messages of any kind (SMS or email, all families: STS, EMA enable, EMA prompts, at-home, payment). Enforced at queue/schedule GENERATION in fetch-data.mjs and again at send time in send-due-messages.mjs. This file is manual — the pipeline reads it but never writes it. To reinstate someone, delete their entry and note why.
